    # SWAP = CNOT(0,1) CNOT(1,0) CNOT(0,1)
    # CNOT(a,b) = H(b) CZ(a,b) H(b)

    qc.h(1)

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
import numpy as np


def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
    # SWAP = exp(i pi/4 (XX + YY + ZZ)) up to a global phase
    # RXX(theta) = exp(-i theta/2 XX)  etc.
    # Hence theta = -pi/2 gives exp(i pi/4 XX)
    qc.rxx(-np.pi / 2, 0, 1)
    qc.ryy(-np.pi / 2, 0, 1)
    qc.rzz(-np.pi / 2, 0, 1)
    return qc
